title: Fog & Thorn Spellery
description: A weathered wooden spell shop stands at the edge of a misty meadow, its facade adorned with hanging herbs, lanterns, and magical curios. An open book rests on a wooden table under a blue awning, with hand-painted signs advertising 'Fog Among the Meadow Trees' and 'Breath of Night On The Snake'.
prompt: A rustic wooden spell shop named Fog & Thorn Spellery stands in a misty autumn meadow surrounded by dark trees. The weathered blue facade has a blue awning, hanging dried herbs, lanterns, and magical items. An open book with a black bird illustration sits on a wooden display table. Hand-painted signs read Fog Among the Meadow Trees 1 dram and Breath of Night On The Snake. Soft diffused light and heavy fog create an atmospheric scene, painted in a realistic oil painting style.
